author: Tjones2122
quote: Woke boyfriend gaming simulator or chore simulator (sims) is best way to describe this game. Extremely disappointing and I want a refund. By far the biggest let down in gaming history. The shooting and driving are absolutely horrible. Probably the most boring game I’ve ever played and I’ve played a good 15 hours or so and still feel the same. Only reason I gave it a one is because the graphics are killer can’t knock that and the radio stations are fire that’s the only 2 good things I can say about it.
